_comment.description: How each competency cluster is named in a report comment. phrase finishes '{He} can …' and 'Next, {he} can …': plain family words, a bare verb phrase, no competency label, code or Ministry wording. skill_key is the teacher/comment-bank.js SKILLS key whose For the Family and support lines fit it, or null. next_steps are the step toward the level above, by the student's level now (an Extending student's next step is the phrase). Keyed by the cluster in data/bc-curriculum-ican.json. The app doesn't read this file yet.
_comment.method: One card per cluster written from the exemplar competency’s Ministry wording and approved I Can set, scripted lint, one independent yes/no checklist review (fidelity, whole cluster, plain grammar, ladder, acceptability), one fix round, and a check that cluster-level text names no art form, trade or subject area that some member course lacks.
_comment.approval: Delegated: Colin Brown asked on Nov 2 2026 for the cards to be treated as approved after one checklist review and one fix round, since he would not see the approval page that night. Not read by Colin card by card.
_comment.schema: Version 2 (Nov 4 2026): a card may add area (the family-facing name of the skill area), forms { base: [the phrase first, then alternatives], did: [past tense, tied to a piece], at: { developing, proficient, extending: [the strength at that level, after {he}] }, override: { base: { does, doing } } }, next_steps.extending, evidence (the kind of work that shows the skill), home ([invitations that start with a verb]) and prov. A card without them is version 1; scripts/build-curriculum-bank.mjs migrates it (forms.base = [phrase], the rest empty) and the engine falls back to the version 1 wording. does and doing are derived from each base form by teacher/comment-forms.js.
